question: Should `adaptive` become a shared `markdown.tables` mode available to all channels, or should this PR expose it as a Teams-owned option only?
rationale: The implementation can be repaired either way, but the permanent public config/API boundary affects generated metadata, plugin SDK contracts, docs, and sibling channel renderers.

options.title: Make Adaptive Teams-Owned
options.body: Keep the Adaptive Card rendering option under the Teams plugin boundary and avoid exposing unsupported `adaptive` behavior to sibling channels.

options.title: Make Adaptive Shared-Safe
options.body: Keep the shared enum value but update markdown-core and every direct-IR channel path so unsupported channels preserve table content safely.

options.title: Pause The Direction
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it later if maintainers do not want a new public table-rendering mode now.

recommendation.title: Make Adaptive Teams-Owned
recommendation.body: Keep the Adaptive Card rendering option under the Teams plugin boundary and avoid exposing unsupported `adaptive` behavior to sibling channels.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared config, markdown-core, docs, and plugin API policy, and this owner has recent history across those surfaces.
